notes.title: Update for players requests
notes.content: [p][b]Hello Players,[/b][/p][p]First of all, we want to sincerely apologize.[/p][p]We’re aware that some players had a frustrating experience during the early stages of our game. We're truly sorry for that. We're a small team of just two people at Lunart Team, doing our best to create something meaningful — but there were moments where we fell short, and we take full responsibility for it.[/p][p]We’re carefully listening to all your feedback and working hard to improve the game. We’re learning from our mistakes and making steady progress to provide a better experience for everyone.[/p][p]Your support and patience mean a lot to us. Thank you.[/p][p]— Lunart Team[/p][p][/p][h3]Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Quest system[/p][/*][*][p]Game time[/p][/*][*][p]Demo finish day[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Economy[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug Fix[/h3][list][*][p]Pushing our own cart with a wheelbarrow fixed[/p][/*][*][p]tasks overlap fixed[/p][/*][*][p]garbage collection mission is not going, new mission is not coming fixed[/p][/*][*][p]I can't finish the day fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Ui fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Npc behaviours fixed [/p][/*][*][p]Order deliver bugs fixed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Localizations[/h3][list][*][p] We noticed some problems with localization and removed it from the demo. We will present it to you without any errors in the next version.[/p][/*][/list]
